text:
ravi: heads up — ArgoWave (acct AGW-776) has invoice INV-2025-341 at 60 days overdue. Sales says CFO called and asked to push due date 45 days + split remaining balance. cc @nora @lee

nora: do we have any active disputes or usage discrepancies? I see a small credit note (CR-78) for $300 that hasn't been applied. total outstanding in system is $22,700 before credit.

lee: Legal and collections guidance needed. we usually don't extend net terms without PA. also need approval to suspend services if they miss the extended date.

marta: Marta (Accounts) 2: can we apply the $300 credit and reissue an invoice? they asked for 45-day push plus two installments.

ravi: Sales-bot forwarded an email: "we can do 45-day push + split remaining into 2 equal payments, customer will provide card on file." they offered 10% admin fee waiver if we accept card instead of ACH.

nora: quick math — outstanding after credit = $22,400. proposal: push due date 45 days, then two payments of $11,200 each 30 days apart. waive admin fee; keep standard late interest if missed. require card on file and signed extension form.

lee: Legal OK to use extension form + require card auth. include clause: immediate service suspension and collections resume after 7-day cure. do not waive interest — but we can discount interest by up to 50% as one-off to preserve relationship. need Omkar sign-off for any financial concession.

marta: billing-bot please create revision and apply CR-78. Also set billing note to mandate card token capture.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-341 (rev 2) created; credit CR-78 applied. New outstanding: $22,400. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2025-341/rev2 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Temporary hold on aggressive escalation for AGW-776 while extension form pending. Reminder scheduled in 10 days.

ravi: Sales will send extension acceptance email and card token. if we get card token + signed form, approve the plan and push dates. who signs off on interest discount?

lee: Legal suggests we avoid unilateral discounts; request finance approval and note in the PA. @omkar please advise.

marta: once card token is captured, billing can set auto-charge on due dates. if charge fails, trigger 24hr retry then notify collections.

ravi: Sales-bot uploaded customer's acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs. they said "we can do this if you reissue invoice showing the split and hold services active."

nora: tagging Omkar (finance) for interest concession: can we offer 50% off accrued interest only (not principal) if both installments clear within 5 days of due dates?

lee: include clause that acceptance of card token authorizes auto-charge for the agreed installments. also include rollback if customer disputes charge later; require contact window for disputes.

collections-bot: Note: if auto-charge declines twice, account flags for escalation and service suspension may proceed.

omkar: Omkar here 2: approve applying credit and creating rev2. For interest concession, approve up to 25% discount on accrued interest — need CRO or Head of Revenue sign-off for >25%. Approve plan contingent on signed extension form, card token captured, and sales confirmation of payment schedule. I'll sign off on waiver after seeing token + signed doc.

ravi: thanks. I'll coordinate with Sales to get the signed form and token and update thread. timeline: send form today, waiting on CFO reply by EOD tomorrow. if no response, remove hold and resume standard collections on day 11. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta: noted. billing will queue auto-charge upon receiving token.

sales-bot: Sales note added to CRM: "Extension requested; CFO confirming. Card token pending."

ravi: closing loop — will post update when token + signed form received. everyone ok with this approach? :thumbsup:

lee: +1

omkar: +1 pending token

nora: +1

marta: +1

ravi: thanks all.
